title: Google Maps Business Leads Input
description: Find local businesses on Google Maps and read their own websites for emails, phone numbers and social profiles.

mode.title: What do you want to do?
mode.description: Search Google Maps, look up specific places, or enrich a list of websites you already have.
enumTitles: Look up specific Google Maps places
Get contacts from a list of websites

searchQueries.title: Search phrases
searchQueries.description: Natural-language searches such as 'coffee shops in Austin TX'. Include the place in each phrase, or use the location field below.
searchQueries.sectionDescription: Used when the selected mode is 'Search Google Maps for businesses'.

locationQuery.title: Location (optional)
locationQuery.description: Adds a shared location to every search phrase, for example 'Austin, TX, USA'. Leave empty when your phrases already name the place.

category.title: Category
category.description: Business category such as bakery, dentist or plumber. Used when keyword and search phrases are empty.

keyword.title: Keyword (overrides category)
keyword.description: Custom search term such as 'boutique coffee' or 'pet grooming'. Takes priority over category.

state.title: US state
state.description: US state for the search. Choose 'All' for nationwide. Ignored for non-US countries.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country for the search. Other countries can be named directly in a search phrase.

websites.title: Business websites
websites.description: Websites to read for contact details, one per line. Bare domains such as example.com are accepted.
websites.sectionDescription: Used when the selected mode is 'Get contacts from a list of websites'.

placeUrls.title: Google Maps place URLs
placeUrls.description: Google Maps place links copied from the address bar or a previous export.
placeUrls.sectionDescription: Used when the selected mode is 'Look up specific Google Maps places'. Provide links, Place IDs, or both.

placeIds.title: Google Place IDs
placeIds.description: Canonical Google Place IDs starting with 'ChIJ'.

max_results.title: Maximum leads
max_results.description: Maximum number of leads to save. Google returns a ranked window of roughly 150-220 businesses per search phrase, so a larger request may end when that window ends.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Keep only businesses rated at least this value (1.0-5.0). Leave empty for any rating.

extractEmails.title: Find emails and social profiles
extractEmails.description: Visit each business website for public emails, phone numbers and social profiles. Turn off for a faster Maps-only run.

maxEmailsPerWebsite.title: Emails per website
maxEmailsPerWebsite.description: Maximum email addresses to keep for one business website.

maxContactPagesPerWebsite.title: Pages checked per website
maxContactPagesPerWebsite.description: Homepage plus contact, about, legal, privacy or careers pages to read. More pages find more contacts but take longer.

onlySaveResults.title: Which places to save
onlySaveResults.description: Save every business, only businesses with an email, or only businesses with any contact detail.
enumTitles: Only businesses with any contact detail

categoryFilter.title: Category filter words
categoryFilter.description: Keep places whose Google Maps category contains all words of at least one entry. Leave empty for no category filter.

websiteFilter.title: Website filter
websiteFilter.description: Keep all places, only places with a website, or only places without one.

skipClosedPlaces.title: Skip closed places
skipClosedPlaces.description: Check Google's public status and leave out permanently or temporarily closed places.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the Google Maps interface and listing text.
